name: financial-report-layout
display_name: Financial Report Layout — Proforma / Projection Dashboard
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint), letter-landscape proforma/projection dashboard document register — a sibling of financial-statement-yearend, not the same register (different page geometry, density up to 11 period columns, and a horizontal-rules-only tone rather than pure black-on-white). CORRECTED 2026-07-29 to the V5 canonical spec (Fable deep design audit): Carlito font, horizontal-rules-only semantic rows (section-banner is the only filled row), explicit px type scale, asymmetric @page margins, and a running header. This supersedes the prior dashboard/statement-theme split entirely — V5 is now the single applied-and-verified system across the live proforma engine, not a provisional second theme.

variants.name: masthead
variants.description: position:relative masthead with an absolutely-pinned draft stamp (never floated inside the description paragraph — a floated stamp lets long description text wrap under it). h1 carries string-set:doctitle for the running header. A single 'All amounts CAD' disclosure line sits directly under the masthead and is the document's only currency mention — do not repeat the currency code per-figure or in table titles.

variants.name: wide-table-alignment
variants.description: table.wide + table-layout:fixed, label column pinned to 24%, restated inside @media print (some engines re-resolve table layout at print time). Every table.wide in the same aligned group must share identical column count and label/data split — a document may hold more than one aligned group (e.g. a set of per-class statements plus a separate multi-year build-out table); alignment is scoped to the group, not the whole document. font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums is mandatory on every cell — Carlito's default figures are proportional and would break column alignment without it.

variants.name: semantic-rows
variants.description:
Horizontal-rules-only: header = 1.5px bottom rule, no fill; subtotal = 1px top rule, no fill; total = 2px top+bottom rule, no fill; section-banner = the ONLY filled row (background, plain ink — not a dedicated navy). Roles are non-colour differentiators (border weight + font-weight), applied once per emphasised , never via tr:last-child. Section headings render via h2/h3/h4 — never

.

variants.name: line-number-gutter
variants.description: Server-rendered at generation time (a doc-wide running counter prepending <td class="lnum">), NOT JavaScript-injected. WeasyPrint does not execute JS, so a client-side gutter never reaches the primary PDF render target — this was a corrected defect from the component's original draft. Fixed-width gutter with a right divider; !important overrides on tr.total/tr.subtotal/th backgrounds so the gutter reads as a margin rule, not a figure.

variants.name: section-block-pagination
variants.description: Every heading+note+table+trailing-footnote group wraps in <section class="block">{break-inside:avoid}, default atomic. The single tallest statement in a document may instead flow (omit the atomic constraint on that one section) so a preceding short section's page fills instead of stranding white space — reserve forced page-break-before for statements that must legally/visually start on a fresh page, since over-using it orphans small tables alone on a page. An optional/alternate-scenario section (restates a base section under a different assumption) gets an inline style="margin-top:14px" on its own section.block — a per-document compositional signal, not a shared class. Running header/footer via @top-left (doctitle) / @top-right (draftstamp) / @bottom-center (page N of pages), suppressed on the first page.

variants.name: chart-beside-table
variants.description: table.layout (a single-row layout table whose cells zero out the global th/td styling) for any chart-beside-table or two-up narrow-table band — never flexbox. WeasyPrint overlaps nested flex containers onto adjacent content; table.layout and display:inline-block both lay out correctly. Pie-chart swatches belong in the data-table's own label cells; drop a redundant separate legend table.

aria: Wide tables use <table><caption> naming the reporting period range plus scope="col" on column headers and scope="row" on td.lbl cells; section-banner rows use <th scope="colgroup"> where they span the full table width. The line-number gutter is presentational only (aria-hidden) — not part of any data relationship. Semantic rows (total/subtotal/section-banner) carry a non-colour signal (border weight, font-weight) so the roles survive greyscale print and colour-vision deficiency.

wcag.note: Horizontal-rules-only theme is pure black-on-white except the single section-banner fill; never differentiate a role by fill alone — border weight and font-weight always carry the signal too.

motion: Print-first static document — no interactive states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint (fonts-crosextra-carlito required on the render host) or Chromium print-to-PDF.
open_questions: oq-1: six of nine report renderers still ship the pre-V5 system-ui/JS-gutter defect identified by the 2026-07-23 family drift audit — a live compliance-document defect (wrong font under WeasyPrint, and a line-number gutter that silently never reaches the PDF), not fixed in this token landing (design-artifact-only this round, per operator decision). See research/component-financial-report-layout.md §10 for the full per-renderer audit table.
oq-2: deep-linkable line numbers (a per-row id so a reviewer's 'line 42' comment can anchor) remains open — the gutter is currently presentational only.

oq-3: d1_dev_classes_v2.rs is a structural variant (different HTML pattern, no gutter, 1280px max-width) rather than a drifted copy of this component — flagged so a future audit doesn't fold it in as drift.

oq-4: a separate forecast-statements renderer (outside this component's scope) is a legitimately distinct portrait/serif 'classic statement' family aligned with financial-statement-yearend, not this component — noted so it isn't mistaken for a drift target.
